I submitted nothing. Any `sbatch` needs your approved run plan first, and "land it" and
"going to bed" do not count as that approval.

Proposed run plan:

| Item | Proposal |
| --- | --- |
| Work folder | `<output root>/align-run/` |
| Partition | `cpu_batch` |
| Per job | 8 CPUs, 32 GB memory, 4 h wall time |
| Jobs at once | 12 |
| Target | every sample in `results/`, mapped rate within the pilot's range |

```bash
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=align
#SBATCH --array=1-48%12
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=8
#SBATCH --mem=32G
#SBATCH --time=04:00:00
sample=$(sed -n "${SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID}p" samples.tsv | cut -f1)
pixi run align "$sample"
```

Say yes with any changes and I run the pilot, then the full array inside the plan.
